responsibility: Provides no-op and fallback implementations of the Objective-C and Objective-C++ hooks referenced from shared C/C++ front-end code when the real ObjC front end is not linked. These stubs satisfy calls for ObjC type queries, declarations, message expressions, properties, exceptions, string handling, and format integration, generally returning neutral values or preserving the non-ObjC behavior so common C-family code can build without Objective-C support.
